data.text:
Goal: split wf into a stable kernel and command groups, with no behaviour change. The kernel is the router, Args and the page lock in src/lib.rs; the shared helpers in src/cmd/mod.rs; the page frame in src/page.rs; and the kind list in src/page/rules/mod.rs. Every page pulls from it and it rarely changes, so forks of work can run in parallel (Matthew t565s2260). Each command group sits on top in its own file, src/cmd/<group>.rs, with its rules in src/page/rules/<group>.rs. Band door: 90.50.10.0400. Acting lead and Prime: Claude (t562u).
Current pass: 05.01, the move. Pack text: labs/0426-plan/PACK-0426-05.01.txt on returns.
Builder: set at pack, one Grok builder (Matthew relays the prompt). Checker: Grok-Check.
Lab: the lab trial tests/lab_0426.rs is written on 90.50.10.0701 by another view after this pass closes. It is not a Done when line of this pass.
Done when: src/cmd.rs is gone, and its code is in src/cmd/mod.rs (shared helpers) and src/cmd/start.rs, plan.rs, build.rs, sync.rs, check.rs, close.rs and lock.rs, as in labs/0426-plan/README.md section 3; the return lists every function's old and new place.
Done when: src/lib.rs keeps only Args, the page lock, writes() and the router; each group's help lines and dispatch live in its own file.
Done when: src/page.rs keeps load, the chain check, the types and the order and apply frame; the kind list and each kind's rules are under src/page/rules/.
Done when: nothing behaves differently: wf help, and a full page loop's log and views, are byte for byte the same as at the start commit, with only times and time-dependent hashes normalised (tests/page_0426.rs).
Done when: every tests/page_*.rs and tests/lab_*.rs from the start commit passes unchanged, and the tests/wf.rs Windows failures are no worse; the return lists each result before and after.
Done when: no file outside the grant changed, and git diff -M shows moved code, not rewritten logic.
Done when: cargo test --lib and cargo test --test page_0426 pass on the box.

Planned work for 90.50.10.0426 split-commands. Source: labs/0426-plan/README.md on returns. Decision: Matthew t565s2260 (Nov 23, 3:17 PM EST).

One pass, 05.01, a move only, done by one Grok builder and checked by Grok-Check.
May touch: src/cmd.rs (deleted), src/cmd/, src/lib.rs, src/page.rs, src/page/, tests/page_0426.rs.

Why: nearly every command lives in src/cmd.rs (984 lines at a823ee28), with dispatch in src/lib.rs and every kind's rules in src/page.rs. So 0408, 0423, 0425, 0409, 0406, 0411, 0412 and 0422 all queue for the same files. After the split, a page holds only its own group file and rule file, plus one line in src/lib.rs or src/page/rules/mod.rs when it adds a group or a kind.

Order: 0423 closed and its trial done; then 0426; then 0425 (Codex) and 0422.05.01 (Claude).
Not in this grant: src/render.rs, src/status.rs, src/board.rs, src/log.rs, src/chars.rs, src/git.rs, src/addr.rs, templates, docs and existing tests. Callers keep working through re-exports.
After it closes: Matthew records the new 0422 grant (labs/0422-plan/README.md C9), and Codex writes the 0425 pack against the real layout.

Read before draft 05.01: face 04 holds the planned work (entry 4), there is no earlier face 06, and there is no closed 05. Matthew t570u (Nov 23, 3:33 PM EST) asked to draft 0426 beside the live kernel: the proof test goes first, in a free file, and the move waits for 0423 to close. So the pass list is now 05.01 proof test (tests/page_0426.rs only) and 05.02 move (labs/0426-plan/README.md, revision 2). Start is the returns tip bcf0680e, today's layout. Builder: Grok-3 (D:\Git\grok3), assigned by Matthew as Claude's builder (Nov 23). 0424, packed earlier naming Grok-3 and still unclaimed, needs another builder; raised in the lead report. Typed by Claude as this page's Prime (t562u). This is the note a draft requires.

fields.outcome: tests/page_0426.rs pins wf's outside behaviour so that the 0426.05.02 move can be proved unchanged; it runs wf as a binary only, never calls src/ code, and passes on today's layout; it compares wf help and a full page loop's log and views against a golden copy kept inside the test file, after a normalisation that removes only times, hashes, commit ids and temp paths; an ignored test regenerates the golden from whatever wf is built, so 05.02 can refresh it at its own start commit before moving any code
fields.overview: Builder: Grok-3 (Matthew's PC, D:\Git\grok3). Checker: Grok-Check (wf check --as Grok-Check). Lead: Claude (acting lead, t562u), who reviews for Matthew. Page 90.50.10.0426, title split-commands, pass 05.01 of two (plan: labs/0426-plan/README.md on returns). Why: Matthew t565s2260 (stable kernel split) and t570u (draft 0426 beside the live kernel: write the proof test now, in a free file, so the move itself is quick and checkable). 05.02 is the move and waits for 0423 to close. This pass touches no src/ file. The test calls the built wf binary (env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_wf") or the way tests/wf.rs and tests/common/mod.rs already do), so it keeps working when the code moves between files. You may use tests/common, but do not change it. Windows is the box: no std::os::unix, no sh, and no check command that is only true, grep or test. Use local bare git remotes in a temp folder, never the network. Build into your own CARGO_TARGET_DIR, never into the pinned wf-bin. Until 0422.05.03's trial passes, also push your report with docs/plan/REPORTS.md (kind build). If wf fails, follow docs/plan/MANUAL-RETURN.md. This pack is template 4, so the return must fill the design review line.
fields.stop if: you would change any file outside may touch (the return check refuses it); the test needs a src/ change or a change to tests/common (stop and raise it); a loop step behaves differently between two runs for a reason other than time, hashes or paths (stop and raise it, it is a finding); a rule above reads two ways; Matthew's direction would leave the grant (stop and raise it). The checks only prove the test compiles and passes; the checker judges whether the golden really pins the outside behaviour, whether the normaliser hides anything it should not, and whether the negative test fails for the right reason
fields.w01: A full page loop, run by the test with the built binary in a temp run folder with a local bare remote: init-page, set-prime, face-write 01, 04 (goals) and 08, face-write 06 note, draft, pack, claim, a builder commit inside the grant, return, check by a second actor, signoff, close, verify, status and board. Capture every command's stdout, stderr and exit code, the final log.jsonl, and every view file under the page folder. If a step needs something wf does not have at your start commit, leave that step out and name it in the return.
fields.w02: Normalise the capture, and only this: ISO times and the time_s numbers become <time>; 64-hex and 40-hex values and any 12-hex prefix printed after "hash", "head", "commit" or "start" become <hex>; the temp folder path becomes <root>; Windows backslashes in paths under <root> become /. Nothing else changes. Write the normaliser as one small function with its own unit test, which shows that two runs of the loop give identical normalised output.
fields.w03: Keep the golden copy inside tests/page_0426.rs, between the lines // GOLDEN BEGIN and // GOLDEN END, as one raw string per capture (wf help, each command's output and exit code, the log, and each view). The main test fails if anything differs, and prints the first differing capture and line.
fields.w04: Add an ignored test, regenerate_golden, run with cargo test --test page_0426 -- --ignored regenerate_golden. It runs the loop and wf help, and rewrites only the text between the GOLDEN markers in tests/page_0426.rs. Running it twice in a row leaves the file unchanged. 05.02 runs it at its own start commit, before it moves any code.
fields.w05: Add one negative test: a copy of the loop with one deliberate difference (for example a face 01 text one word longer) must make the comparison fail. This shows the test can fail.
fields.w06: In proof:, paste cargo test --test page_0426 (all pass), the regenerate run twice with git diff showing no change the second time, and cargo test --lib.
